name: EnemyScale
description: Enemy health, damage and speed grow exponentially (compounding) every wave instead of linearly: each stat is multiplied by (1 + growth)^wave. Defaults are 5% / 5% / 0% per wave, all adjustable with sliders in Mod Options.

hp_percent_per_wave.title: Enemy health growth per wave
hp_percent_per_wave.tooltip: Compounds every wave: multiplier = (1 + this)^wave. 5% means wave 2 is x1.05, wave 3 is x1.10, wave 20 is x2.65.

damage_percent_per_wave.title: Enemy damage growth per wave
damage_percent_per_wave.tooltip: Compounds every wave: multiplier = (1 + this)^wave. 5% means wave 2 is x1.05, wave 3 is x1.10, wave 20 is x2.65.

speed_percent_per_wave.title: Enemy speed growth per wave
speed_percent_per_wave.tooltip: Compounds every wave: multiplier = (1 + this)^wave. 0% = off (changes the game a lot).
